title: 18 AL/BC patterns: style, data-modeling, web-services, appsource, breaking-changes, performance, testing
summary: 18 new AL/BC development patterns added covering style conventions, data modeling, web services, AppSource, breaking changes, performance, and testing guidance with code examples.
key_points: 7 style patterns addressing identifier naming, casing, type choices, and namespace verification
4 data modeling patterns for DimensionManagement wiring, posting routines, primary key immutability, and setup field validation
3 web service patterns for FlowFields, editable key fields, and derived field recalculation on API pages
Individual patterns for AppSource (File datatype), breaking changes (Email module preference), performance (Word layout), and testing (randomized data)
Each pattern includes bad and good code examples with frontmatter metadata and description
quote: 18 knowledge articles generalized from patterns observed across real AppSource/PTE Business Central development
